https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/job-boa.description: A Job Board is a website that allows job seekers to search and apply for job openings and employers to post job openings and search resumes.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/panel-i.title: Panel Interview
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/panel-i.description: A Panel Interview is an interviewing method in which multiple interviewers question a candidate simultaneously.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/direct-.title: Direct Placement
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/direct-.description: Direct Placement refers to placing employees directly into permanent positions within an organization. Direct Placement is often used for highly skilled jobs requiring a long-term commitment from the employee.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/job-cla.title: Job Classification
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/job-cla.description: Job Classification is the process of organizing and grouping jobs in an organization based on their characteristics, duties, and responsibilities.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/strateg.title: Strategic Staffing
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/strateg.description: Strategic Staffing is the process of aligning a company’s workforce with its long-term goals and objectives through careful planning, recruitment, and development of employees.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.title: Talent Relationship Management
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.description: Talent Relationship Management (TRM) is an organization’s strategy and process to identify, attract, and retain top talent.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/workfor.title: Workforce planning
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/workfor.description: Workforce Planning is the process of identifying and addressing the current and future needs of an organization’s workforce.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/work-tr.title: Work Trial
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/work-tr.description: A Work Trial is a period of time during which a job candidate is given the opportunity to work in a job or role on a temporary basis in order to evaluate their suitability for the position.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/yield-r.title: Yield ratio HR
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/yield-r.description: Yield Ratios are a type of financial ratio that are used to measure the efficiency of an investment.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/replace.title: Replacement Charts
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/replace.description: A Replacement Chart is a tool used to help organizations identify and prioritize potential replacements for critical organizational positions.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/resume-.title: Resume Parsing
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/resume-.description: Resume Parsing is extracting information from a resume and storing it in a structured format, typically in a database or Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/skills-.title: Skills gap
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/skills-.description: Skills Gap refers to the difference between the skills that employees currently possess and the skills that employers need or require for a certain job or role.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/social-.title: Social media screening
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/social-.description: Social Media Screening refers to the process of reviewing a candidate’s online presence and social media profiles to assess their qualifications and suitability for a job.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/work-be.title: Work Behavior
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/work-be.description: Work Behavior refers to the actions and attitudes that an individual exhibits while at work.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/employm.title: Employment Status
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/employm.description: Employment Status refers to the legal relationship between an individual and an organization for which they work.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/roster-.title: Roster Management
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/roster-.description: Roster Management refers to scheduling and organizing employees’ work hours and shifts within an organization.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/functio.title: Functional Job Analysis
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/functio.description: Functional Job Analysis (FJA) evaluates the tasks, duties, and responsibilities that make up a specific job in an organization.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/lateral.title: Lateral hiring
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/lateral.description: Lateral Hiring refers to the process of hiring experienced individuals for roles at the same level as their current or previous job.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/conting.title: Contingency recruiting
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/conting.description: Contingency Recruiting is a type of recruitment in which a company or organization works with a recruitment agency or search firm to find and hire candidates for open positions.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/contrac.title: Contract Recruiter
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/contrac.description: A Contract Recruiter is a professional hired temporarily or per project to help a company find and hire new employees.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/interna.title: Internal Recruiter
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/interna.description: An internal recruiter is an employee of a company who is responsible for recruiting and hiring new staff within the organization.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/people-.title: People Operations
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/people-.description: People Operations is the department responsible for managing and improving all aspects of an organization’s workforce, such as recruitment, employee development, and retention.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/referen.title: Reference Check HR
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/referen.description: A Reference Check is a process of contacting and verifying the information provided by an individual’s references, typically as part of the hiring process.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/backgro.title: Background Check HR
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/backgro.description: A background check is a process of verifying an individual’s personal, employment, and/or criminal history to ensure the safety and security of the employer, landlord, or organization.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/screeni.title: Screening Interview
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/screeni.description: Screening Interviews are short, initial interviews to evaluate and select the most suitable candidates to proceed to the next round of the hiring process.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/job-kno.title: Job Knowledge Tests
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/job-kno.description: A Job Knowledge Test is an assessment designed to measure an individual’s understanding of the skills and knowledge required for a particular job or role.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.description: The role of a Talent Acquisition Partner often involves developing and implementing strategies to identify and attract top talent and managing the recruitment process from start to finish.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/david-u.title: David Ulrich HR Model
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/david-u.description: The David Ulrich, Human Resource Model, is a framework for aligning human resource management (HRM) practices with an organization’s overall goals and strategy.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/g-facto.title: G factor intelligence
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/g-facto.description: The G Factor refers to the concept in psychometrics and intelligence research that posits a general cognitive ability that underlies specific mental abilities and is measured by intelligence tests.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.title: Talent Rediscovery
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.description: Talent rediscovery is helping individuals identify and develop their innate abilities and talents, often after a period of not using or exploring those talents.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.title: Talent mapping
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.description: Talent mapping is identifying, tracking, and developing the skills and abilities of individuals within an organization.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/interna.title: Internal Assessment HR
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/interna.description: Internal Assessment is a process of evaluating employee performance, skills, and development within an organization, typically conducted by the employee’s manager or supervisor.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/univers.title: Universal Competency Framework
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/univers.description: The Universal Competency Framework (UCF) is a set of skills and knowledge that are considered essential for effective performance in a particular field or profession.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/value-b.title: Value based recruitment
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/value-b.description: Values-based recruitment is a method of hiring employees that focuses on finding individuals who align with the values and culture of the organization.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/percept.title: Perception bias
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/percept.description: Perception bias refers to the tendency to perceive things in a certain way due to preconceptions, stereotypes, or personal experiences, which can lead to inaccurate conclusions.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/conform.title: Conformity Bias
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/conform.description: Conformity bias is a type of bias that occurs when individuals conform to the beliefs, attitudes, or behaviors of others, often without fully thinking through or evaluating those beliefs.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/micro-b.title: Micro behaviours HR
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/micro-b.description: Micro-behaviors are small, specific actions or reactions that make up larger, more complex behaviors.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/contras.title: Contrast effect
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/contras.description: Contrast-effect is a psychological phenomenon in which the perception of one thing is influenced by the comparison with another thing.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/job-enr.title: Job Enrichment
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/job-enr.description: Job enrichment makes a job more interesting and challenging by increasing the responsibility, autonomy, and skill required.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/job-sha.title: Job Shadowing
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/job-sha.description: Job shadowing is a learning opportunity that allows an individual to observe and follow a worker as they go about their daily tasks and responsibilities.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/conditi.title: Conditions of employment
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/conditi.description: Conditions of employment refer to the terms and conditions that govern an individual’s relationship with their employer.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/in-bask.title: In-Basket Training
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/in-bask.description: In-basket training simulates management tasks by giving trainees a set of simulated tasks, messages and information to prioritize.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/acqui-h.title: Acqui-Hiring
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/acqui-h.description: Acqui-hiring, also known as talent acquisition, is a type of corporate strategy in which a company acquires another company primarily for the purpose of hiring its employees.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/seasona.title: Seasonal Employment
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/seasona.description: Seasonal employment refers to jobs that are tied to specific seasons or certain months of the year, usually, these jobs are short-term, and the employees are temporary.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/behavio.title: Behavioural Competency
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/behavio.description: Behavioral competency refers to skills demonstrated through behavior that are used in evaluating job performance. Examples include communication, leadership, and teamwork.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.title: Talent Pipeline
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/talent-.description: A talent pipeline is a strategic approach to recruiting and hiring that focuses on identifying, attracting, and developing a pool of qualified candidates for current and future job openings.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/hiring-.title: Hiring Surge
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/hiring-.description: A hiring surge is a period of time in which a company or organization experiences an increase in demand for new employees.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/it-recr.title: IT Recruiter
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/it-recr.description: An IT recruiter is a specialized professional responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring IT talent for organizations. These recruiters ensure the candidates they bring in meet the organization’s technical and cultural requirements.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/workfor.title: Workforce Analysis
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/workfor.description: Workforce analysis is a process in which HR managers and other stakeholders evaluate the current workforce to identify strengths, weaknesses, and areas for improvement.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/attriti.title: Attrition Rate
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/attriti.description: The attrition rate, also known as turnover rate, is a measure of how many employees leave an organization over a given period of time.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/hr-chat.title: HR Chatbots
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/hr-chat.description: HR chatbots are artificial intelligence (AI) software programs designed to assist with HR tasks and support employees.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/recruit.title: Recruitment Drive
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/recruit.description: A recruitment drive is an organized effort to identify and attract potential candidates for open job positions within a company.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/applica.title: Applicant Pool
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/applica.description: An applicant pool is a group of individuals who have applied for a specific job or program.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/targete.title: Targeted Recruiting
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/targete.description: Targeted recruiting is a strategy organizations use to seek out and recruit individuals with the specific skills, experience, and qualifications needed to fill a position.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/employe.title: Employee Assessment
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/employe.description: Employee assessment is the process of evaluating an employee’s job performance and potential.

https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/candida.title: Recruitment Funnel
https://testlify.com/hr-glossary/candida.description: The candidate funnel is a process used to identify, evaluate, and select job applicants for a particular position.

https://testlify.com/ja/psychometric-tes.description: 採用・育成のための心理テストの威力を発揮する 当社の最先端の心理テストソリューションにより、情報に基づいた採用の意思決定や優秀な人材の見極めが容易になります。 サイコメトリーテストとは？ 心理テストとは、個人の精神的な能力、行動、人格的な特徴を測定するために用いられる評価です。 具体的な業務遂行能力、チームでの効果的な働き方、組織文化への適合性など、候補者のポテンシャルを知ることができます。 採用における心理テストのメリット 心理テストは、客観的な候補者評価、バイアスの軽減、採用判断の改善など、採用プロセスにおいて多くのメリットをもたらします。 専門家が作成した心理テスト 当社の心理テストは、心理テストやアセスメント開発センターの分野で20年以上の経験を持つ業界の専門家が監修しています。 Testlifyでは、すべての心理測定テストは、テストの科学的構成と顔の妥当性を確立するために、徹底した内容検証、ピアレビュー、モデレーションを受けます。 テスト構築プロセス 各コンセプトのテストは、最新のトレンドや研究情報を考慮した上で、徹底したリサーチプロセスを経ています。 すべての心理測定ツールの開発は、包括的なアセスメントテストのフレームワークによって導かれています。 制作時のコンテンツの検証 IO心理士がテスト資料を作成した後、心理テストの専門家によるサニタリーチェックが行われます。 テストの社会的望ましさと信頼性が損なわれていないことを確認するために、ピアバリデーションが実施されます。 テストの試行錯誤 テストは、パイロットグループに実施した後に収集したデータを分析することで、心理学的な品質を確認することができます。 これには、テストの内部一貫性の計算、項目の難易度と識別力の評価、中心傾向とばらつきの測定が含まれます。 ベストインクラステストを提供 分析結果をもとに、テスト内容の調整を行い、正確性と効率性を高めています。 これらのステップを経て、心理テストは、スキル、性格特性、行動様式を評価する正確で偏りのない方法を探している雇用主や人々であるクライアントに、利用可能な最良の選択肢として提供されるのです。 テストライブラリから様々な心理テストを選択、または要件に合わせてカスタマイズすることができます サイコメトリーテストベスト6をご紹介 よくある質問（FAQ） Testlifyについてもっと知りたいですか？ 当社に関するよくあるご質問についてお答えします。

500以上の検証済みアセスメントのコレクションからベースとなるテンプレートを選択し、ニーズに応じてスキルや質問を変更することができます。 また、アセスメントビルダーを利用して、ゼロから作成することも可能です； 職種を入力すると、プラットフォームが関連するスキルセットと質問事項を提供します。 統合されたワークフロー https://testlify.com/ja/about/.title: です；
https://testlify.com/ja/about/.description: 私たちは、採用プロセスに人間味を取り戻すためにTestlifyを開発しました 採用活動は、人そのもの――その人の可能性、経歴、スキル――に焦点を当てるべきものです。しかし、いつの間にか、採用は煩わしいものとなってしまいました。終わりのない履歴書の山、性急な決定、そして偏った選考が横行しているのです。 Testlifyは、透明性、公平性、そして共感をもってこの現状を変えようと開発されました。なぜなら、すべての応募の背後には一人の人間がおり、すべての決定の背後には、最善を尽くそうとするチームがいるからです。 小さなアイデアから世界的な採用プラットフォームへ 「採用プロセスをすべての人にとってより良いものにする」という使命を掲げる小さなチームです。2021年、当社の創業者は、すべての採用担当者、採用責任者、そして求職者が抱えるある問題に気づきました： 採用プロセスは機能不全に陥っていた。遅く、偏見があり、一貫性がなく、そのほとんどが手作業だった。 もっと良い方法があるはずだ。そこで私たちは、明確さ、公平性、そしてスピードをもって不要な要素を排除するように設計された、インテリジェントな評価・面接プラットフォーム「Testlify」を開発しました。 当初は小さな自力での取り組みに過ぎなかったものが、今では世界中に100名以上の思いやりのあるメンバーを擁するチームへと成長し、日々数千人の人事担当者にサービスを提供しています。 100+ 採用の未来を築く、世界中で拡大を続けるチーム。 50,000+ 世界中の採用担当者が、Testlifyを活用して自信を持って採用を行っています。 500万人以上 候補者は、Testlifyのスキル評価を通じて評価されます。 私たちのあらゆる意思決定の指針となる原則 私たちの企業文化、製品、そしてより良い採用への取り組みを支える中核となる信念。 私たちの取り組み 採用は単なるプロセスではなく、責任ある仕事です。 私たちは、誰もが機会を得られるべきだと考えています。そのため、収益の1％を、雇用の創出、スキルの向上、若者のエンパワーメントを支援するNGOに寄付しています。 採用がより公平になれば、世界はより良くなる。 当社のリーダーシップ Abhishek Shah 創業者兼CEO Namrata Kamdar 共同創業者兼最高執行責任者 Jiten Modi 共同創業者兼CTO Akash Patange マーケティング部長 Ritu Doshi 財務責任者 Pradeep Panicker 営業部長 Usha Seshan 評価責任者 Anuraag Raman カスタマーサクセス・ディレクター Sankalp Menon シニア・プロダクトデリバリー・マネージャー Tej Gala リードプロダクトストラテジスト Arushi Shah 人事・人材担当 ×…
